Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface TrainingParticipationService

All Known Implementing Classes:
TrainingParticipationServiceImpl
public interface TrainingParticipationService
Service interface for training participation management operations. This interface defines the contract for managing user participation in training programs including registration, completion tracking, certification, and participation analytics.

Key training participation services include:

  • Participation Registration: Enrolling users in training programs
  • Completion Tracking: Monitoring and updating training completion status
  • Participation History: Retrieving user training participation records
  • Analytics invalid input: '&' Reporting: Training participation statistics and time analysis
  • Certificate Management: Handling training certificates and completions
  • Notification Integration: Automatic notifications for participation events

This service ensures proper tracking of user training progress, maintains comprehensive training records, and provides valuable participation analytics for training program evaluation.

  • Method Details

    • registerTrainingParticipation

      void registerTrainingParticipation(Long requesterId, NewTrainingParticipationDTO newTrainingParticipationDTO)
      Registers a user's participation in a training program. Creates a new training participation record and handles notification workflows.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the registration request
      newTrainingParticipationDTO - the participation data including training and user details

    • findTrainingParticipationsByUser

      List<TrainingParticipationDTO> findTrainingParticipationsByUser(Long requesterId, Long userId)
      Retrieves all training participation records for a specific user. Returns comprehensive participation history including completion status and certificates.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the request (for authorization)
      userId - the ID of the user whose participation records to retrieve
      Returns:
      list of TrainingParticipationDTO objects representing the user's training history

    • getTrainingParticipationTimeByYearByUser

      LinkedHashMap<Integer,Long> getTrainingParticipationTimeByYearByUser(Long requesterId, Long userId)
      Retrieves training participation time statistics by year for a specific user. Provides annual breakdown of training time investment for performance analysis.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the request (for authorization)
      userId - the ID of the user whose training time statistics to retrieve
      Returns:
      LinkedHashMap with year as key and total training time (in hours) as value
